content: Web Page Builder » Pre-Made Elements Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000074302 The ability to insert pre-made content elements into custom web pages and landing pages is now available. These elements can be used to create all kinds of custom landing pages. Available Pre-Made Elements There are 14 available pre-made elements to choose from: Image Video Button Link Contact Form Text Block Section Title Divider Line Line Break Text With Image Right Text with image Left Three Column Feature List Four Column Feature List FAQ Module Pricing Plan Use the Pre-Made Elements Add content to a static page in My Content >> Web Page Builder >> Click " Edit " for existing page OR click New Web Page button to create a new web page: Once on the web page, search for the "Pre-Made Elements" on the right sidebar: Drag and Drop the elements into the static page: Customize and Edit the elements by using the FROALA Editor options: Live Example This is an example of a page that uses the pre-made elements: This page uses 1 "Text with Image Left" and 1 "Text with Image Right" blocks: Video Important Notes The FAQ module is a static display, so it won’t expand or collapse when clicked. It’s designed for straightforward, always-visible answers. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
